method: arXiv API search/abstract reads and the vLLM documentation, read 2026-11-17 UTC; no claim is from memory

sources.title: Consensus as Privileged Context for Label-Free Self-Distillation
sources.claim: samples multiple solutions, extracts the majority answer, conditions a frozen model snapshot on a solution that reaches it, and supervises the model on its own rollouts at every token; pass@1 up to +12 points; +6 points over label-free RL at a seventh of its compute; approaches a gold-conditioned teacher
sources.partial: their teacher conditions on a consensus solution only; stage 3 also requires the train-label-verified condition

sources.title: Recurrent Self-Improvement: Dynamic Cross-Loop On-Policy Distillation for Looped Language Models
sources.claim: LoopOPD uses a frozen terminal loop policy as a compute-privileged teacher for an intermediate loop student on student rollouts, without an external teacher or privileged information; D-LoopOPD refreshes the terminal teacher; math training also improves general reasoning and code
sources.partial: the teacher is the terminal loop of the same model, not a frozen R=1 snapshot with a consensus+verified solution

sources.title: Small Models Struggle to Learn from Strong Reasoners
sources.claim: small models (<=3B) do not consistently benefit from long CoT or distillation from larger models; shorter/simpler reasoning chains align better; Mix Distillation improves small-model reasoning

sources.title: MiCoTA: Bridging the Learnability Gap with Intermediate CoT and Teacher Assistants
sources.claim: intermediate-sized teacher assistants and intermediate-length CoT; Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct improve 3.47 and 3.93 on average on AIME2024, AMC, Olympiad, MATH-500 and GSM8K
sources.partial: the numbers are Qwen2.5 7B/3B averages, not Qwen3.5-0.8B single-task gains

sources.title: Teaching Pretrained Language Models to Think Deeper with Retrofitted Recurrence
sources.claim: a curriculum of recurrences converts pretrained non-recurrent LMs into depth-recurrent ones; better performance at a given compute budget than post-training the original non-recurrent model on mathematics
sources.partial: the internal reading records the GSM8K 46.2 -> 52.0 point at 32x inference compute, not matched inference compute

sources.title: Retrofitting Recurrent Depth into a Pretrained Language Model: Installation, Extrapolation, Transfer, and Retention at Two Parameter Budgets
sources.claim: Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct split into Prelude/weight-tied Recurrent Block/Coda with an identity-preserving one-loop path and re-entry bridge; non-inferior at loop 1; 6M and 180M budgets; 83.8% vs 84.0%; 53% vs 2.5% beyond depth 10; 7.6x faster than a scratchpad model
sources.partial: different model (0.5B) and task battery (ARC), not Qwen3.5-0.8B on GSM8K/MATH

sources.title: Distilling System 2 into System 1
sources.claim: self-supervised methods compile higher-quality System 2 outputs back into generations without intermediate reasoning tokens; improved over System 1 with less inference cost than System 2
sources.partial: distils inference-time techniques, not a teacher's consensus+verified solution; no single universal point gain

sources.title: Reinforcement Learning for Reasoning in Large Language Models with One Training Example
sources.claim: one RLVR example moves Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B MATH500 36.0% -> 73.6% (8.6% beyond format correction) and the six-benchmark average 17.6% -> 35.7% (7.0% non-format); matches the 1.2k DeepScaleR subset; two examples slightly exceed it
sources.number_warning: 8.6 is the beyond-format-correction gain, not the total MATH500 gain (+37.6 points)

sources.title: On-Policy Distillation of Language Models: Learning from Self-Generated Mistakes
sources.claim: trains the student on its self-generated output sequences using teacher feedback, instead of a fixed output set; evaluated on summarization, translation and arithmetic reasoning
sources.partial: encoder-decoder/small students, not post-trained Qwen3.5-0.8B at 20M tokens

sources.title: Qwen3.5 & Qwen3.6 Usage Guide
sources.claim: serves Qwen/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B and Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B with --language-model-only, --reasoning-parser qwen3, the enable_thinking chat-template flag, prefix caching and optional MTP-1
sources.unsupported: the page does not name the 0.8B/2B chat checkpoints; it is not a small-checkpoint recipe

sources.title: vLLM Supported Models
sources.claim: lists Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration with example Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B-Instruct; notes Qwen-3.5 is hybrid-only and needs --language-model-only for text-only
sources.partial: the example is 9B-Instruct; the 0.8B/2B checkpoint support is not stated on this page

number_mismatches.claim_that_would_be_wrong: retrofitted recurrence improves GSM8K 46.2 -> 52.0 at matched inference compute
number_mismatches.source_says: the 52.0 point is at test recurrence 32; recurrence 1 is 25.6; the matched claim is about training FLOPs
MATH500 moves 36.0 -> 73.6 (+37.6 points); 8.6 is the improvement beyond format correction

number_mismatches.claim_that_would_be_wrong: CANON improves pass@1 by 12 points and beats RL by 12 points
number_mismatches.source_says: 12 is the pass@1 gain; 6 is the over-RL margin; 1/7 is the compute fraction
the recipe page is for 397B-A17B and 35B-A3B; the supported-models page is family-level with a 9B-Instruct example
+3.47/+3.93 are Qwen2.5-7B/3B-Instruct averages over five tasks

number_mismatches.claim_that_would_be_wrong: D-LoopOPD conditions its teacher on consensus+gold
number_mismatches.source_says: the teacher is the terminal loop of the same model, without an external teacher or privileged information
